ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefits_summary: Short-term revolving credit up to ₹3,00,000 for crops, animal husbandry, and fisheries at an effective 4% p.a. interest rate on timely repayment.
application_steps: Visit your nearest Rural, Cooperative, or Commercial Bank branch or apply via PM-KISAN portal.
Submit land records and cropping pattern details.
Collect your Kisan Credit Card cum RuPay debit card after sanction.
